// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

import {
  VoiceAgentSession,
  type IdleTimeoutConfig,
  type Reasoner,
  type ReasonerMessage,
  type ReasonerSessionStore,
  type VoicePlugin,
  type PluginConfig,
} from "@kuralle-syrinx/core";
import { RealtimeBridge, type RealtimeAdapter } from "@kuralle-syrinx/realtime";
import { ReasoningBridge } from "@kuralle-syrinx/aisdk";

/** Per-session context handed to every pipeline factory. */
export interface VoicePipelineContext {
  readonly sessionId: string;
  /**
   * G4 resume state for the session, present when durable history is on. The
   * `front()` factory wires it into the adapter: `resumeHistory: ctx.resume.history`
   * on replay providers (OpenAI), `sessionResumptionHandle: ctx.resume.providerHandle`
   * on native-resume providers (Gemini — do NOT also replay, R6).
   */
  readonly resume?: {
    /** Live view of the durable transcript (call again on reconnect for the current state). */
    readonly history: () => readonly { readonly role: "user" | "assistant"; readonly content: string }[];
    /** Latest provider-native resume handle, when one was issued. */
    readonly providerHandle?: string;
  };
}

/** Host wiring (withVoice) threaded into the assembled session. */
export interface VoiceSessionWiring {
  /** G4: durable store for the cascaded ReasoningBridge's conversation history. */
  readonly reasonerSessionStore?: ReasonerSessionStore;
  /** G4: prior-context provider for realtime delegate turns (live view of durable history). */
  readonly contextProvider?: () => readonly ReasonerMessage[];
  /** G3: ms before a pending tool call fires its "delayed" (still-working) cue. */
  readonly delayCueAfterMs?: number;
  /**
   * Idle-timeout override. Defaults to the 15s telephony re-engagement. Browser/edge
   * hosts pass `{ durationMs: 0 }` to disable it — a playground/demo user granting mic
   * or reading the UI should never be nagged ("Are you still there?") or disconnected.
   */
  readonly idleTimeout?: Partial<IdleTimeoutConfig>;
}

/**
 * Realtime front pipeline: a single speech-to-speech model (Gemini Live,
 * OpenAI Realtime, …) owns STT+TTS+turn-taking; the reasoner is consulted via a
 * front-model delegate tool. Assembled exactly as the verified realtime path:
 * `plugins: { realtime: {} }`, `endpointingOwner: "timer"`.
 */
export interface RealtimePipeline<Env> {
  readonly kind: "realtime";
  /** The realtime front adapter, e.g. `fromGeminiLive(...)` / `fromOpenAIRealtime(...)`. */
  readonly front: (env: Env, ctx: VoicePipelineContext) => RealtimeAdapter;
  /** Name of the front-model tool routed to the reasoner. @default "consult_knowledge" */
  readonly delegateToolName?: string;
  /**
   * How the delegate answer reaches the front model (G1): `"envelope"` (default) wraps
   * it as a `DelegateResultEnvelope` (`response_text` + `require_repeat_verbatim`);
   * `"string"` injects the raw answer.
   */
  readonly toolResultFormat?: "envelope" | "string";
  /** Optional `render` directive included in the envelope, e.g. `"translate_faithfully"`. */
  readonly renderDirective?: string;
}

/** A cascaded-stage plugin plus its `VoiceAgentSession` plugin config. */
export interface CascadedStage {
  readonly plugin: VoicePlugin;
  readonly config?: PluginConfig;
}

/**
 * Cascaded pipeline: discrete STT → reasoner → TTS stages (optionally VAD + a
 * Smart-Turn EOS). Assembled exactly as the verified cascaded path:
 * `plugins: { stt, vad?, eos?, bridge, tts }`, reasoner wrapped in a
 * `ReasoningBridge` registered as `"bridge"`.
 */
export type CascadedEndpointingOwner = "provider_stt" | "smart_turn";

export interface CascadedPipeline<Env> {
  readonly kind: "cascaded";
  readonly stt: (env: Env, ctx: VoicePipelineContext) => CascadedStage;
  readonly tts: (env: Env, ctx: VoicePipelineContext) => CascadedStage;
  readonly vad?: (env: Env, ctx: VoicePipelineContext) => CascadedStage;
  /** Optional EOS stage. Returning `undefined` is equivalent to omitting the stage. */
  readonly eos?: (env: Env, ctx: VoicePipelineContext) => CascadedStage | undefined;
  /**
   * Which component owns end-of-speech. @default "provider_stt". Set to
   * "smart_turn" when supplying an `eos` stage. May be a static literal or an
   * `(env) => owner` factory for per-request selection (e.g. smart_turn only
   * when Workers AI is bound).
   */
  readonly endpointingOwner?: CascadedEndpointingOwner | ((env: Env) => CascadedEndpointingOwner);
  /**
   * Fallback timeout (ms) before the engine force-finalizes a turn when the STT provider's own
   * endpointing/finalize never fires. Maps to `VoiceAgentSession`'s `sttForceFinalizeTimeoutMs`
   * (engine default 7000). Set it when a provider-endpointed cascade tunes this (e.g. Deepgram at 3500).
   */
  readonly sttForceFinalizeTimeoutMs?: number;
  /**
   * Speculative generation: start the reasoner on an eager end-of-turn signal
   * (`eos.interim` — Deepgram Flux `eager_eot_threshold`, smart-turn interim) and
   * commit/discard when the endpoint confirms. Trades extra LLM calls for
   * parallelizing LLM TTFT with endpoint confirmation. @default false
   */
  readonly speculative?: boolean;
}

export type VoicePipeline<Env> = RealtimePipeline<Env> | CascadedPipeline<Env>;

/**
 * Assemble a `VoiceAgentSession` for the configured pipeline. This is the single
 * place that maps the high-level pipeline config onto Syrinx's plugin slots, so
 * the realtime and cascaded shapes stay first-class instead of mode-flagged.
 */
export function buildVoiceSession<Env>(
  pipeline: VoicePipeline<Env>,
  env: Env,
  reasoner: Reasoner | undefined,
  ctx: VoicePipelineContext,
  wiring: VoiceSessionWiring = {},
): VoiceAgentSession {
  if (pipeline.kind === "realtime") {
    const front = pipeline.front(env, ctx);
    const bridge = new RealtimeBridge(front, reasoner, pipeline.delegateToolName, {
      ...(pipeline.toolResultFormat !== undefined ? { toolResultFormat: pipeline.toolResultFormat } : {}),
      ...(pipeline.renderDirective !== undefined ? { renderDirective: pipeline.renderDirective } : {}),
      ...(wiring.contextProvider ? { contextProvider: wiring.contextProvider } : {}),
    });
    const session = new VoiceAgentSession({
      plugins: { realtime: {} },
      endpointingOwner: "timer",
      ...(wiring.delayCueAfterMs !== undefined ? { delayCueAfterMs: wiring.delayCueAfterMs } : {}),
      ...(wiring.idleTimeout !== undefined ? { idleTimeout: wiring.idleTimeout } : {}),
    });
    session.registerPlugin("realtime", bridge);
    return session;
  }

  if (!reasoner) {
    throw new Error(
      "withVoice: a cascaded pipeline needs a reasoner. Set `reasoner` in the options, " +
        "or expose a kuralle `runtime` on the Agent so it defaults to fromKuralleRuntime(this.runtime).",
    );
  }

  const stt = pipeline.stt(env, ctx);
  const tts = pipeline.tts(env, ctx);
  const vad = pipeline.vad?.(env, ctx);
  const eos = pipeline.eos?.(env, ctx);
  const endpointingOwner =
    typeof pipeline.endpointingOwner === "function"
      ? pipeline.endpointingOwner(env)
      : pipeline.endpointingOwner;

  if (endpointingOwner === "smart_turn" && !eos) {
    throw new Error(
      'withVoice: a cascaded pipeline with endpointingOwner "smart_turn" must provide an `eos` stage ' +
        "(e.g. a PipecatEOSPlugin); otherwise no component owns end-of-speech and turns never complete.",
    );
  }

  const plugins: Record<string, PluginConfig> = {
    stt: stt.config ?? {},
    bridge: {},
    tts: tts.config ?? {},
  };
  if (vad) plugins["vad"] = vad.config ?? {};
  if (eos) plugins["eos"] = eos.config ?? {};

  const session = new VoiceAgentSession({
    plugins,
    endpointingOwner: endpointingOwner ?? "provider_stt",
    ...(pipeline.sttForceFinalizeTimeoutMs !== undefined
      ? { sttForceFinalizeTimeoutMs: pipeline.sttForceFinalizeTimeoutMs }
      : {}),
    ...(wiring.delayCueAfterMs !== undefined ? { delayCueAfterMs: wiring.delayCueAfterMs } : {}),
    ...(wiring.idleTimeout !== undefined ? { idleTimeout: wiring.idleTimeout } : {}),
  });
  session.registerPlugin("stt", stt.plugin);
  session.registerPlugin(
    "bridge",
    new ReasoningBridge(reasoner, {
      ...(wiring.reasonerSessionStore
        ? { sessionStore: wiring.reasonerSessionStore, sessionId: ctx.sessionId }
        : {}),
      ...(pipeline.speculative ? { speculative: true } : {}),
    }),
  );
  session.registerPlugin("tts", tts.plugin);
  if (vad) session.registerPlugin("vad", vad.plugin);
  if (eos) session.registerPlugin("eos", eos.plugin);
  return session;
}
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
//
// withVoice(Agent) — adds a Syrinx voice pipeline (realtime OR cascaded) to a
// Cloudflare `agents` SDK Agent.
//
// Design (issue #7): a mixin OVER the Agent, not a raw Durable Object. It reuses
// the Agent's native hibernation, `keepAlive()` lease, `Connection`, and SQL —
// it does not reimplement them. Syrinx is the engine: each connection is handed
// to the published `runVoiceEdgeWebSocketConnection(socket, request, options)`
// over the Agent's `Connection` wrapped as a `ManagedSocket`. The agent's own
// kuralle runtime is the brain by default (`fromKuralleRuntime(this.runtime)`),
// so an existing agent gets voice with zero brain re-wiring.
//
// Lifecycle wrap (capture-and-patch of onConnect/onMessage/onClose) mirrors
// `@cloudflare/voice`'s withVoice (voice.ts, MIT, © Cloudflare). Unlike that
// mixin, this one does not implement the voice protocol itself — it delegates the
// whole connection to Syrinx's edge runner.

import type { Agent, Connection, ConnectionContext, WSMessage } from "agents";
import {
  runVoiceEdgeWebSocketConnection,
  type BackgroundAudioConfig,
  type EdgeRecorder,
} from "@kuralle-syrinx/server-websocket/edge";
import { runTwilioEdgeWebSocketConnection } from "@kuralle-syrinx/server-websocket/edge-twilio";
import { InMemorySessionStore } from "@kuralle-syrinx/server-websocket/session-store";
import type { IdleTimeoutConfig, Reasoner, ReasonerMessage } from "@kuralle-syrinx/core";
import { fromKuralleRuntime, type KuralleRuntimeLike } from "@kuralle-syrinx/kuralle";
import {
  connectionManagedSocket,
  type ConnectionSocketController,
  type VoiceConnection,
} from "./connection-socket.js";
import {
  buildVoiceSession,
  type VoicePipeline,
  type VoicePipelineContext,
  type VoiceSessionWiring,
} from "./build-session.js";
import { SqliteReasonerSessionStore, type SqlTag } from "./durable-history.js";

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- mixin constructors require `any[]` rest params (TS2545)
type Constructor<T = object> = new (...args: any[]) => T;

/** Bound on the durable realtime transcript (12 turns), mirroring ReasoningBridge's default window. */
const MAX_DURABLE_HISTORY_MESSAGES = 24;

/** The Agent surface the voice mixin relies on. (`env`/`name`/`runtime` are read via VoiceHostSurface.) */
type AgentLike = Constructor<
  Pick<Agent<Record<string, unknown>>, "sql" | "getConnections" | "keepAlive">
>;

/**
 * Fired the instant the front model invokes the delegate tool — BEFORE the reasoner runs.
 * Lets an app emit a deterministic, in-language preamble or a "thinking" earcon that masks the
 * reasoner's wait, instead of relying on the realtime front LLM to remember to speak one (cf.
 * Vapi/Pipecat `on_function_calls_started`). Use `connection.send(...)` to signal the client
 * (the idiomatic agents-SDK pattern) — e.g. trigger a cached client-side earcon/preamble.
 */
export interface ToolCallStartContext {
  readonly toolName: string;
  readonly args: Record<string, unknown>;
  readonly sessionId: string;
  /** The live agents-SDK connection — `connection.send(json)` to message the client. */
  readonly connection: VoiceConnection;
}

/**
 * Delegate (Responder-Thinker) observability — fired when the bridge hands a query to
 * the Reasoner (G2, RFC bimodel-delegate-seam). Replaces the consumer-side pattern of
 * wrapping the Reasoner just to log the query. `toolId`/`toolName` are present on
 * realtime delegate turns, absent on cascade turns.
 */
export interface DelegateQueryContext<Env = unknown> {
  readonly query: string;
  readonly toolId?: string;
  readonly toolName?: string;
  readonly turnId: string;
  readonly sessionId: string;
  readonly connection: VoiceConnection;
  /** The Worker env — bindings for logging/persistence (e.g. an R2 bucket). */
  readonly env: Env;
}

/**
 * Fired when the Reasoner produced the turn's final answer. Self-contained (carries the
 * query again) so a consumer can log/persist the grounded Q&A pair from this one hook.
 */
export interface DelegateResultContext<Env = unknown> {
  readonly query: string;
  readonly answer: string;
  readonly durationMs: number;
  readonly grounded: boolean;
  readonly toolId?: string;
  readonly toolName?: string;
  readonly turnId: string;
  readonly sessionId: string;
  readonly connection: VoiceConnection;
  /** The Worker env — bindings for logging/persistence (e.g. an R2 bucket). */
  readonly env: Env;
}

export interface WithVoiceOptions<Env> {
  /**
   * The connection wire protocol this host speaks. `"edge"` (default) is the Syrinx
   * browser/edge JSON+envelope protocol (`runVoiceEdgeWebSocketConnection`). `"twilio"`
   * speaks the Twilio Media Streams protocol (μ-law 8 kHz both ways,
   * `runTwilioEdgeWebSocketConnection`) for a PSTN leg. One transport per Agent class —
   * route `/ws` to an `"edge"` agent and `/twilio` to a `"twilio"` agent.
   */
  readonly transport?: "edge" | "twilio";
  /** The voice pipeline: `{ kind: "realtime", ... }` or `{ kind: "cascaded", ... }`. */
  readonly pipeline: VoicePipeline<Env>;
  /**
   * The brain. Defaults to `fromKuralleRuntime(this.runtime, { sessionId })` when
   * the Agent exposes a kuralle `runtime`. Required for cascaded pipelines on
   * agents without a `runtime`.
   */
  readonly reasoner?: (env: Env, ctx: VoicePipelineContext) => Reasoner | Promise<Reasoner>;
  /** Optional per-call recorder (e.g. an R2-backed `EdgeRecorder`). Applies to the `"edge"` transport. */
  readonly recorder?: (env: Env, ctx: VoicePipelineContext) => EdgeRecorder | undefined;
  /**
   * Ambient/thinking bed mixed (ducked) under assistant speech on both transports.
   * On the `"twilio"` transport the bed also fills the gaps between turns as
   * comfort noise — pure digital silence on a phone line reads as "the call died".
   * The thinking loop follows the G3 tool-call cues. Sources are raw mono PCM16
   * (e.g. `ffmpeg -i office.mp3 -ac 1 -ar 16000 -f s16le office.pcm`).
   */
  readonly backgroundAudio?: BackgroundAudioConfig;
  /**
   * Fired when the front model starts a delegate tool call, before the reasoner runs — the seam
   * for a deterministic latency-masking preamble / "thinking" earcon. Throwing here never affects
   * the call. See {@link ToolCallStartContext}.
   */
  readonly onToolCallStart?: (ctx: ToolCallStartContext) => void | Promise<void>;
  /**
   * Delegate observability (G2): fired when the bridge hands a query to the Reasoner.
   * Subscribe instead of wrapping the Reasoner to log. Throwing here never affects the call.
   */
  readonly onDelegateQuery?: (ctx: DelegateQueryContext<Env>) => void | Promise<void>;
  /**
   * Delegate observability (G2): fired when the Reasoner produced the turn's final answer —
   * the hook for logging/persisting the grounded Q&A pair (query + answer + durationMs +
   * grounded). Throwing here never affects the call.
   */
  readonly onDelegateResult?: (ctx: DelegateResultContext<Env>) => void | Promise<void>;
  /**
   * G4 durable session state (default on). Persists the reasoner conversation to the
   * Agent's DO-SQLite so a session resumes with the same context after eviction/
   * hibernation: cascaded pipelines re-seed the ReasoningBridge; realtime pipelines
   * record the transcript, feed it to delegate turns as prior context, and expose it
   * (plus any provider-native resume handle) to the `front()` factory via
   * `ctx.resume`. Set false for the pre-G4 ephemeral behavior.
   */
  readonly durableHistory?: boolean;
  /**
   * G3: ms a pending tool call may run before the time-triggered `tool_call_delayed`
   * ("still working") wire cue fires. 0 disables the delayed phase. Default: 2000.
   */
  readonly delayCueAfterMs?: number;
  /**
   * Idle-timeout override for this host. Omitted → the 15s telephony re-engagement
   * ("Are you still there?" then disconnect). Browser/edge hosts should pass
   * `{ durationMs: 0 }` to disable it: a demo/playground user granting mic or reading
   * the UI must not be nagged or hung up on. Leave the default on `"twilio"` hosts.
   */
  readonly idleTimeout?: Partial<IdleTimeoutConfig>;
  readonly inputSampleRateHz?: number;
  readonly outputSampleRateHz?: number;
  readonly resumeWindowMs?: number;
  /**
   * Derive the Syrinx session id. Defaults to the `?sessionId=` query param, then
   * the Agent instance `name` (each routed DO instance is one stable session).
   */
  readonly sessionId?: (request: Request, agentName: string) => string;
}

export interface WithVoiceMembers {
  /** Force-end the voice session on a connection (e.g. moderation, takeover). */
  forceEndVoice(connection: VoiceConnection): void;
}

/** Loose view of the host instance for the capture-and-patch wiring. */
interface VoiceHostSurface {
  readonly env: unknown;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly runtime?: unknown;
  keepAlive(): Promise<() => void>;
  onConnect?(connection: Connection, ctx: ConnectionContext): unknown;
  onMessage?(connection: Connection, message: WSMessage): unknown;
  onClose?(connection: Connection, code: number, reason: string, wasClean: boolean): unknown;
}

function isKuralleRuntime(value: unknown): value is KuralleRuntimeLike {
  return (
    typeof value === "object" &&
    value !== null &&
    typeof (value as { run?: unknown }).run === "function"
  );
}

export function withVoice<Env, TBase extends AgentLike>(
  Base: TBase,
  options: WithVoiceOptions<Env>,
): TBase & Constructor<WithVoiceMembers> {
  class VoiceAgentMixin extends Base implements WithVoiceMembers {
    // One session store per DO instance — resumes a dropped connection within
    // the agent's lifetime (keyed by the stable session id).
    readonly #store = new InMemorySessionStore();
    readonly #controllers = new Map<string, ConnectionSocketController>();
    readonly #keepAliveDispose = new Map<string, () => void>();

    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- mixin constructor must accept any args
    constructor(...args: any[]) {
      super(...args);
      const host = this as unknown as VoiceHostSurface;
      const onConnect = host.onConnect?.bind(this);
      const onMessage = host.onMessage?.bind(this);
      const onClose = host.onClose?.bind(this);

      host.onConnect = (connection: Connection, ctx: ConnectionContext) => {
        this.#startVoice(connection, ctx);
        return onConnect?.(connection, ctx);
      };

      host.onMessage = (connection: Connection, message: WSMessage) => {
        const controller = this.#controllers.get(connection.id);
        if (controller) {
          controller.message(message as string | ArrayBuffer);
          return undefined;
        }
        return onMessage?.(connection, message);
      };

      host.onClose = (connection: Connection, code: number, reason: string, wasClean: boolean) => {
        this.#endVoice(connection, code, reason);
        return onClose?.(connection, code, reason, wasClean);
      };
    }

    forceEndVoice(connection: VoiceConnection): void {
      // Pump close so the edge runner tears down and the lease releases, then
      // close the underlying socket.
      this.#controllers.get(connection.id)?.close(1000, "force_end");
      try {
        connection.close(1000, "force_end");
      } catch {
        /* already closing */
      }
    }

    #startVoice(connection: Connection, ctx: ConnectionContext): void {
      const host = this as unknown as VoiceHostSurface;
      const env = host.env as Env;
      const request = ctx.request;
      const sessionId = this.#resolveSessionId(request);
      // The agents `Connection.send` is runtime-compatible with a ManagedSocket
      // (workerd's WebSocket.send accepts string/ArrayBuffer/ArrayBufferView), but
      // its lib type is nominally stricter (ArrayBuffer- vs ArrayBufferLike-backed
      // views). Bridge that single boundary structurally.
      const voiceConnection = connection as unknown as VoiceConnection;
      const { socket, controller } = connectionManagedSocket(voiceConnection);
      this.#controllers.set(connection.id, controller);

      // Release the keepAlive lease + drop the controller on ANY close — a client
      // close (pumped via the Agent's onClose hook) OR an edge-runner-initiated
      // socket.dispose() (idle / max-duration / startup failure). The socket fires
      // its close handlers in both cases, so this does not depend on the platform
      // delivering a server-initiated onClose.
      socket.onClose(() => this.#releaseConnection(connection.id));

      // Hold a keepAlive lease for the duration of the call so the DO is not
      // evicted mid-conversation.
      void this.keepAlive()
        .then((dispose) => {
          if (this.#controllers.has(connection.id)) {
            this.#keepAliveDispose.set(connection.id, dispose);
          } else {
            // Connection already closed before the lease resolved.
            dispose();
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {
          // keepAlive() failed — the call still runs (the open socket keeps the
          // isolate live), it is just not protected from idle eviction.
        });

      // Both runners assemble the session the same way — pipeline + (resolved) reasoner.
      const createSession = async () => {
        // G4 durable session state: load prior context from DO-SQLite, expose it to the
        // factories via ctx.resume, and wire persistence per pipeline kind.
        const durable = options.durableHistory !== false ? this.#durableStore() : undefined;
        const liveHistory: ReasonerMessage[] = durable ? [...durable.load(sessionId)] : [];
        const providerHandle = durable?.loadResumeHandle(sessionId);
        const ctx: VoicePipelineContext = {
          sessionId,
          ...(durable
            ? {
                resume: {
                  history: () =>
                    liveHistory
                      .filter((m): m is ReasonerMessage & { role: "user" | "assistant" } =>
                        m.role === "user" || m.role === "assistant")
                      .map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content })),
                  ...(providerHandle ? { providerHandle } : {}),
                },
              }
            : {}),
        };
        const wiring: VoiceSessionWiring = {
          ...(options.delayCueAfterMs !== undefined ? { delayCueAfterMs: options.delayCueAfterMs } : {}),
          ...(options.idleTimeout !== undefined ? { idleTimeout: options.idleTimeout } : {}),
          ...(durable
            ? options.pipeline.kind === "realtime"
              ? { contextProvider: () => liveHistory }
              : { reasonerSessionStore: durable }
            : {}),
        };
        const reasoner = await this.#resolveReasoner(env, ctx);
        const session = buildVoiceSession(options.pipeline, env, reasoner, ctx, wiring);
        // Realtime pipelines have no ReasoningBridge to own history — record the
        // transcript from the bus and persist the bounded snapshot per turn. The
        // cascaded path persists inside ReasoningBridge instead (heard-prefix aware).
        if (durable && options.pipeline.kind === "realtime") {
          const persist = (): void => {
            if (liveHistory.length > MAX_DURABLE_HISTORY_MESSAGES) {
              liveHistory.splice(0, liveHistory.length - MAX_DURABLE_HISTORY_MESSAGES);
            }
            try {
              durable.save(sessionId, liveHistory);
            } catch {
              /* persistence must never fail the call */
            }
          };
          // The realtime bridge pushes llm.done (assistant transcript) BEFORE
          // eos.turn_complete (user transcript) for the same turn — buffer the
          // assistant text and commit the pair in conversation order at turn end.
          const pendingAssistant = new Map<string, string>();
          session.bus.on("llm.done", (pkt) => {
            const done = pkt as { contextId: string; text?: string };
            if (done.text?.trim()) pendingAssistant.set(done.contextId, done.text);
          });
          session.bus.on("eos.turn_complete", (pkt) => {
            const turn = pkt as { contextId: string; text?: string };
            const assistantText = pendingAssistant.get(turn.contextId);
            pendingAssistant.delete(turn.contextId);
            if (turn.text?.trim()) liveHistory.push({ role: "user", content: turn.text });
            if (assistantText) liveHistory.push({ role: "assistant", content: assistantText });
            if (turn.text?.trim() || assistantText) persist();
          });
          session.bus.on("realtime.resumption_handle", (pkt) => {
            const handle = (pkt as { handle?: string }).handle;
            if (!handle) return;
            try {
              durable.saveResumeHandle(sessionId, handle);
            } catch {
              /* persistence must never fail the call */
            }
          });
        }
        // Surface the tool-call-start seam: VoiceAgentSession emits `agent_tool_call` the instant
        // the front model invokes the delegate tool, before the reasoner runs. A throwing app
        // callback must never break the call, so it is fully isolated.
        if (options.onToolCallStart) {
          session.on("agent_tool_call", (e) => {
            try {
              void Promise.resolve(
                options.onToolCallStart!({ toolName: e.name, args: e.args, sessionId, connection: voiceConnection }),
              ).catch(() => undefined);
            } catch {
              /* app hook threw synchronously — ignore */
            }
          });
        }
        // Delegate observability (G2): surface the bridge's delegate.query/delegate.result
        // packets as app hooks. Same isolation contract as onToolCallStart — a throwing app
        // callback must never break the call.
        if (options.onDelegateQuery) {
          session.on("delegate_query", (e) => {
            try {

   501	      return this.#durable;
   502	    }
   503	
   504	    // Default: the client-supplied `?sessionId=` (so a reconnecting client can
   505	    // resume its session within the resume window), else a per-connection random
   506	    // id. Crucially NOT the Agent name — two concurrent connections to one
   507	    // instance must not silently share (and cross-wire) a single VoiceAgentSession.
   508	    #resolveSessionId(request: Request): string {
   509	      const name = (this as unknown as VoiceHostSurface).name;
   510	      if (options.sessionId) return options.sessionId(request, name);
   511	      try {
   512	        const fromQuery = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get("sessionId");
   513	        if (fromQuery) return fromQuery;
   514	      } catch {
   515	        /* malformed URL — fall through to a random id */
   516	      }
   517	      return crypto.randomUUID();
   518	    }
   519	  }
   520	
   521	  return VoiceAgentMixin as unknown as TBase & Constructor<WithVoiceMembers>;
   522	}

   183	/** Loose view of the host instance for the capture-and-patch wiring. */
   184	interface VoiceHostSurface {
   185	  readonly env: unknown;
   186	  readonly name: string;
   187	  readonly runtime?: unknown;
   188	  keepAlive(): Promise<() => void>;
   189	  onConnect?(connection: Connection, ctx: ConnectionContext): unknown;

   191	  onClose?(connection: Connection, code: number, reason: string, wasClean: boolean): unknown;
   192	}
   193	
   194	function isKuralleRuntime(value: unknown): value is KuralleRuntimeLike {
   195	  return (
   196	    typeof value === "object" &&
   197	    value !== null &&
   198	    typeof (value as { run?: unknown }).run === "function"
   199	  );
   200	}
   201	
   202	export function withVoice<Env, TBase extends AgentLike>(
   203	  Base: TBase,
   204	  options: WithVoiceOptions<Env>,
   205	): TBase & Constructor<WithVoiceMembers> {
   206	  class VoiceAgentMixin extends Base implements WithVoiceMembers {
   207	    // One session store per DO instance — resumes a dropped connection within
   208	    // the agent's lifetime (keyed by the stable session id).
   209	    readonly #store = new InMemorySessionStore();
   210	    readonly #controllers = new Map<string, ConnectionSocketController>();
   211	    readonly #keepAliveDispose = new Map<string, () => void>();
   212	
   213	    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- mixin constructor must accept any args
   214	    constructor(...args: any[]) {
   215	      super(...args);
   216	      const host = this as unknown as VoiceHostSurface;
   217	      const onConnect = host.onConnect?.bind(this);
   218	      const onMessage = host.onMessage?.bind(this);
   219	      const onClose = host.onClose?.bind(this);
   220	
   221	      host.onConnect = (connection: Connection, ctx: ConnectionContext) => {
   222	        this.#startVoice(connection, ctx);
   223	        return onConnect?.(connection, ctx);
   224	      };
   225	
   226	      host.onMessage = (connection: Connection, message: WSMessage) => {
   227	        const controller = this.#controllers.get(connection.id);
   228	        if (controller) {
   229	          controller.message(message as string | ArrayBuffer);
   230	          return undefined;
   231	        }
   232	        return onMessage?.(connection, message);
   233	      };
   234	
   235	      host.onClose = (connection: Connection, code: number, reason: string, wasClean: boolean) => {
   236	        this.#endVoice(connection, code, reason);
   237	        return onClose?.(connection, code, reason, wasClean);
   238	      };
   239	    }
   240	
   241	    forceEndVoice(connection: VoiceConnection): void {
   242	      // Pump close so the edge runner tears down and the lease releases, then
   243	      // close the underlying socket.
   244	      this.#controllers.get(connection.id)?.close(1000, "force_end");
   245	      try {
   246	        connection.close(1000, "force_end");
   247	      } catch {
   248	        /* already closing */
   249	      }
   250	    }
   251	
   252	    #startVoice(connection: Connection, ctx: ConnectionContext): void {
   253	      const host = this as unknown as VoiceHostSurface;
   254	      const env = host.env as Env;
   255	      const request = ctx.request;
   256	      const sessionId = this.#resolveSessionId(request);
   257	      // The agents `Connection.send` is runtime-compatible with a ManagedSocket
   258	      // (workerd's WebSocket.send accepts string/ArrayBuffer/ArrayBufferView), but
   259	      // its lib type is nominally stricter (ArrayBuffer- vs ArrayBufferLike-backed
   260	      // views). Bridge that single boundary structurally.
   261	      const voiceConnection = connection as unknown as VoiceConnection;
   262	      const { socket, controller } = connectionManagedSocket(voiceConnection);
   263	      this.#controllers.set(connection.id, controller);
   264	
   265	      // Release the keepAlive lease + drop the controller on ANY close — a client
   266	      // close (pumped via the Agent's onClose hook) OR an edge-runner-initiated
   267	      // socket.dispose() (idle / max-duration / startup failure). The socket fires
   268	      // its close handlers in both cases, so this does not depend on the platform
   269	      // delivering a server-initiated onClose.
   270	      socket.onClose(() => this.#releaseConnection(connection.id));
   271	
   272	      // Hold a keepAlive lease for the duration of the call so the DO is not
   273	      // evicted mid-conversation.
   274	      void this.keepAlive()
   275	        .then((dispose) => {
   276	          if (this.#controllers.has(connection.id)) {
   277	            this.#keepAliveDispose.set(connection.id, dispose);
   278	          } else {
   279	            // Connection already closed before the lease resolved.
   280	            dispose();
   281	          }
   282	        })
   283	        .catch(() => {
   284	          // keepAlive() failed — the call still runs (the open socket keeps the
   285	          // isolate live), it is just not protected from idle eviction.
   286	        });
   287	
   288	      // Both runners assemble the session the same way — pipeline + (resolved) reasoner.
   289	      const createSession = async () => {
   290	        // G4 durable session state: load prior context from DO-SQLite, expose it to the
   291	        // factories via ctx.resume, and wire persistence per pipeline kind.
   292	        const durable = options.durableHistory !== false ? this.#durableStore() : undefined;
   293	        const liveHistory: ReasonerMessage[] = durable ? [...durable.load(sessionId)] : [];
   294	        const providerHandle = durable?.loadResumeHandle(sessionId);
   295	        const ctx: VoicePipelineContext = {
   296	          sessionId,
   297	          ...(durable
   298	            ? {
   299	                resume: {
   300	                  history: () =>
   301	                    liveHistory
   302	                      .filter((m): m is ReasonerMessage & { role: "user" | "assistant" } =>
   303	                        m.role === "user" || m.role === "assistant")
   304	                      .map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content })),
   305	                  ...(providerHandle ? { providerHandle } : {}),
   306	                },
   307	              }
   308	            : {}),
   309	        };
   310	        const wiring: VoiceSessionWiring = {
   311	          ...(options.delayCueAfterMs !== undefined ? { delayCueAfterMs: options.delayCueAfterMs } : {}),
   312	          ...(options.idleTimeout !== undefined ? { idleTimeout: options.idleTimeout } : {}),
   313	          ...(durable
   314	            ? options.pipeline.kind === "realtime"
   315	              ? { contextProvider: () => liveHistory }
   316	              : { reasonerSessionStore: durable }
   317	            : {}),
   318	        };
   319	        const reasoner = await this.#resolveReasoner(env, ctx);
   320	        const session = buildVoiceSession(options.pipeline, env, reasoner, ctx, wiring);
   321	        // Realtime pipelines have no ReasoningBridge to own history — record the
   322	        // transcript from the bus and persist the bounded snapshot per turn. The
   323	        // cascaded path persists inside ReasoningBridge instead (heard-prefix aware).
   324	        if (durable && options.pipeline.kind === "realtime") {
   325	          const persist = (): void => {
   326	            if (liveHistory.length > MAX_DURABLE_HISTORY_MESSAGES) {
   327	              liveHistory.splice(0, liveHistory.length - MAX_DURABLE_HISTORY_MESSAGES);
   328	            }
   329	            try {
   330	              durable.save(sessionId, liveHistory);
   331	            } catch {
   332	              /* persistence must never fail the call */
   333	            }
   334	          };
   335	          // The realtime bridge pushes llm.done (assistant transcript) BEFORE
   336	          // eos.turn_complete (user transcript) for the same turn — buffer the
   337	          // assistant text and commit the pair in conversation order at turn end.
   338	          const pendingAssistant = new Map<string, string>();
   339	          session.bus.on("llm.done", (pkt) => {
   340	            const done = pkt as { contextId: string; text?: string };
   341	            if (done.text?.trim()) pendingAssistant.set(done.contextId, done.text);
   342	          });
   343	          session.bus.on("eos.turn_complete", (pkt) => {
   344	            const turn = pkt as { contextId: string; text?: string };
   345	            const assistantText = pendingAssistant.get(turn.contextId);
   346	            pendingAssistant.delete(turn.contextId);
   347	            if (turn.text?.trim()) liveHistory.push({ role: "user", content: turn.text });
   348	            if (assistantText) liveHistory.push({ role: "assistant", content: assistantText });
   349	            if (turn.text?.trim() || assistantText) persist();
   350	          });
   351	          session.bus.on("realtime.resumption_handle", (pkt) => {
   352	            const handle = (pkt as { handle?: string }).handle;
   353	            if (!handle) return;
   354	            try {
   355	              durable.saveResumeHandle(sessionId, handle);
   356	            } catch {
   357	              /* persistence must never fail the call */
   358	            }
   359	          });
   360	        }
   361	        // Surface the tool-call-start seam: VoiceAgentSession emits `agent_tool_call` the instant
   362	        // the front model invokes the delegate tool, before the reasoner runs. A throwing app
   363	        // callback must never break the call, so it is fully isolated.
   364	        if (options.onToolCallStart) {
   365	          session.on("agent_tool_call", (e) => {
   366	            try {
   367	              void Promise.resolve(
   368	                options.onToolCallStart!({ toolName: e.name, args: e.args, sessionId, connection: voiceConnection }),
   369	              ).catch(() => undefined);
   370	            } catch {
   371	              /* app hook threw synchronously — ignore */
   372	            }
   373	          });
   374	        }
   375	        // Delegate observability (G2): surface the bridge's delegate.query/delegate.result
   376	        // packets as app hooks. Same isolation contract as onToolCallStart — a throwing app
   377	        // callback must never break the call.
   378	        if (options.onDelegateQuery) {
   379	          session.on("delegate_query", (e) => {
   380	            try {
   381	              void Promise.resolve(
   382	                options.onDelegateQuery!({
   383	                  query: e.query,
   384	                  toolId: e.toolId,
   385	                  toolName: e.toolName,
   386	                  turnId: e.turnId,
   387	                  sessionId,
   388	                  connection: voiceConnection,
   389	                  env,
   390	                }),
   391	              ).catch(() => undefined);
   392	            } catch {
   393	              /* app hook threw synchronously — ignore */
   394	            }
   395	          });
   396	        }
   397	        if (options.onDelegateResult) {
   398	          session.on("delegate_result", (e) => {
   399	            try {
   400	              void Promise.resolve(
   401	                options.onDelegateResult!({
   402	                  query: e.query,
   403	                  answer: e.answer,
   404	                  durationMs: e.durationMs,
   405	                  grounded: e.grounded,
   406	                  toolId: e.toolId,
   407	                  toolName: e.toolName,
   408	                  turnId: e.turnId,
   409	                  sessionId,
   410	                  connection: voiceConnection,
   411	                  env,
   412	                }),
   413	              ).catch(() => undefined);
   414	            } catch {
   415	              /* app hook threw synchronously — ignore */
   416	            }
   417	          });
   418	        }
   419	        return session;
   420	      };

    34	const ENGINE_SAMPLE_RATE_HZ = 16_000;
    35	const FRAME_SAMPLES_20MS = 320;
    36	const FRAME_BYTES_20MS = FRAME_SAMPLES_20MS * 2;

    38	/**
    39	 * G1 — the structured delegate-result envelope (RFC bimodel-delegate-seam §4).
    40	 * The bridge wraps the accumulated reasoner answer in this JSON shape before
    41	 * `injectToolResult`, so the front model treats it as authoritative tool data
    42	 * and repeats it faithfully instead of paraphrasing or inventing facts. Field
    43	 * names mirror OpenAI's Realtime Prompting Guide "Tool Output Formatting"
    44	 * (`response_text` + `require_repeat_verbatim`) — the only field-validated
    45	 * envelope shape, and gpt-realtime is the primary front (OQ1).
    46	 */
    47	export interface DelegateResultEnvelope {
    48	  /** The authoritative answer — the front model's ONLY source of facts for the turn. */
    49	  readonly response_text: string;
    50	  readonly require_repeat_verbatim: true;
    51	  /** Optional app directive the front prompt keys on, e.g. "translate_faithfully". */
    52	  readonly render?: string;
    53	}
    54	
    55	export interface RealtimeBridgeOptions {
    56	  readonly debug?: boolean;
    57	  /**
    58	   * How the delegate answer reaches the front model at `injectToolResult` time.
    59	   * `"envelope"` (default) wraps it as a {@link DelegateResultEnvelope}; `"string"`
    60	   * injects the raw answer (pre-envelope behavior). The envelope is applied to the
    61	   * already-buffered delegate answer — a synchronous JSON.stringify, no added latency
    62	   * (R2) — and never touches the cascade text-delta path. Bus packets
    63	   * (`llm.tool_result`, `delegate.result`) always carry the raw answer.
    64	   */
    65	  readonly toolResultFormat?: "envelope" | "string";
    66	  /**
    67	   * Optional `render` directive included in the envelope (e.g. `"translate_faithfully"`),
    68	   * for front prompts that key a rendering rule on it. Ignored with `toolResultFormat: "string"`.
    69	   */
    70	  readonly renderDirective?: string;
    71	  /**
    72	   * Supplies prior conversation context for delegate Reasoner turns. When omitted the delegate is
    73	   * stateless — each tool call receives only the query extracted from the front-model tool args.
    74	   */
    75	  readonly contextProvider?: () => readonly ReasonerMessage[];
    76	  /**
    77	   * Name of the front-model tool argument that carries the user's query for the delegate Reasoner.
    78	   * Must match the argument name in the registered delegate tool's schema. Defaults to "query".
    79	   */
    80	  readonly delegateQueryArg?: string;
    81	  /**
    82	   * Handle a front-model tool call whose name is NOT the delegate tool — front-level tools like
    83	   * `wait_for_user`, `escalate_to_human`, or `finish_session` that must not hit the reasoner.
    84	   * Return the string to inject back to the front model as the tool result (default `""`). When
    85	   * omitted, a non-delegate tool call remains a recoverable error (the prior behavior).
    86	   */
    87	  readonly onFrontToolCall?: (call: {
    88	    readonly toolId: string;
    89	    readonly toolName: string;
    90	    readonly args: Record<string, unknown>;
    91	  }) => string | undefined | Promise<string | undefined>;
    92	  /**
    93	   * Half-cascade text-only mode: stream assistant transcript into the cascade
    94	   * `llm.delta → segmenter → tts.text` path and ignore provider audio.
    95	   * REQUIRES a TTS plugin registered on the session bus (the bridge does not own the registry).
    96	   */
    97	  readonly textOnly?: boolean;
    98	  /**
    99	   * Syrinx-owned turn detection (REQ-6): on `eos.turn_complete`, call
   100	   * `adapter.requestResponse` so Syrinx endpointing/VAD/InteractionPolicy drives
   101	   * the provider response instead of server VAD.
   102	   *
   103	   * MUST be paired with `turnDetection: null` on the adapter — otherwise the
   104	   * provider's server VAD and Syrinx would BOTH trigger responses (double-turn).
   105	   * Native mode (`syrinxTurns` absent/false) is unchanged.
   106	   */
   107	  readonly syrinxTurns?: boolean;
   108	}

   110	export class RealtimeBridge implements VoicePlugin {
   111	  private bus: PipelineBus | null = null;
   112	  private contextId = "";
   113	  private turnUserText = "";
   114	  /** Authoritative full assistant transcript(s) — providers that emit a final transcript (OpenAI). */
   115	  private turnAssistantText = "";
   116	  /** Concatenated streamed transcript fragments — providers that emit deltas only, no final (Gemini Live). */
   117	  private turnAssistantDeltas = "";
   118	  private sessionAbort: AbortController | null = null;
   119	  private inflight: AbortController | undefined;
   120	  private delegateTask: Promise<void> | null = null;
   121	  private playedMs = 0;
   122	  private audioRemainder: Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike> = new Uint8Array(0);
   123	  private readonly disposers: Array<() => void> = [];
   124	
   125	  constructor(
   126	    private readonly adapter: RealtimeAdapter,
   127	    private readonly reasoner?: Reasoner,
   128	    private readonly delegateToolName = "consult_knowledge",
   129	    private readonly opts: RealtimeBridgeOptions = {},
   130	  ) {}
   131	
   132	  async initialize(bus: PipelineBus, _cfg: PluginConfig): Promise<void> {
   133	    this.bus = bus;
   134	    this.sessionAbort = new AbortController();
   135	
   136	    this.disposers.push(
   137	      bus.on<UserAudioReceivedPacket>("user.audio_received", (pkt) => {
   138	        const resampled = resamplePcm16Bytes(
   139	          pkt.audio,
   140	          ENGINE_SAMPLE_RATE_HZ,
   141	          this.adapter.caps.inputSampleRateHz,
   142	        );
   143	        this.adapter.sendAudio(resampled);
   144	      }),
   145	      bus.on<UserTextReceivedPacket>("user.text_received", (pkt) => {
   146	        if (pkt.text.trim().length > 0) this.adapter.sendText?.(pkt.text);
   147	      }),
   148	      bus.on<TextToSpeechPlayoutProgressPacket>("tts.playout_progress", (pkt) => {
   149	        if (pkt.contextId === this.contextId) this.playedMs = pkt.playedOutMs;
   150	      }),
   151	      bus.on<InterruptTtsPacket>("interrupt.tts", () => {
   152	        this.adapter.cancelResponse(this.playedMs);
   153	        this.inflight?.abort();
   154	      }),
   155	    );
   156	
   157	    if (this.opts.syrinxTurns) {
   158	      this.disposers.push(
   159	        bus.on("eos.turn_complete", () => {
   160	          this.adapter.requestResponse?.();
   161	        }),
   162	      );
   163	    }
   164	
   165	    await this.adapter.open(this.sessionAbort.signal);
   166	    void this.pump();
   167	  }
   168	
   169	  async close(): Promise<void> {
   170	    this.sessionAbort?.abort();
   171	    this.inflight?.abort();
   172	    for (const dispose of this.disposers.splice(0)) dispose();
   173	    await this.adapter.close();
   174	    this.bus = null;
   175	    this.sessionAbort = null;
   176	  }
   177	
   178	  private async pump(): Promise<void> {
   179	    const bus = this.bus;
   180	    if (!bus) return;
   181	
   182	    try {
   183	      for await (const ev of this.adapter.events) {
   184	        if (!this.bus) return;
   185	        await this.handleEvent(bus, ev);
   186	      }
   187	    } catch (err) {
   188	      if (!this.bus || isAbortError(err)) return;
   189	      this.onError(
   190	        this.bus,
   191	        err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)),
   192	        false,
   193	      );
   194	    }
   195	  }
   196	
   197	  private async handleEvent(bus: PipelineBus, ev: RealtimeEvent): Promise<void> {
   198	    switch (ev.type) {
   199	      case "response_started":
   200	        this.onResponseStarted(bus);
   201	        break;
   202	      case "audio":
   203	        // textOnly: provider audio must not be used (REQ-4) — TTS plugin owns playout.
   204	        if (!this.opts.textOnly) this.onAudio(bus, ev.pcm16, ev.sampleRateHz);
   205	        break;
   206	      case "transcript":
   207	        if (ev.role === "user") {
   208	          if (ev.final) this.onFinalTranscript(bus, ev.text);
   209	        } else if (this.opts.textOnly) {
   210	          // Drive cascade TTS path as text arrives; do not buffer for display-only re-emit.
   211	          this.onTextOnlyAssistantTranscript(bus, ev.text, ev.final);
   212	        } else if (ev.final && ev.text.trim()) {
   213	          this.turnAssistantText = this.turnAssistantText
   214	            ? `${this.turnAssistantText} ${ev.text.trim()}`
   215	            : ev.text.trim();
   216	        } else if (!ev.final && ev.text) {
   217	          // Streamed fragments already carry their own leading spaces — concatenate verbatim.
   218	          this.turnAssistantDeltas += ev.text;
   219	          bus.push(Route.Main, {
   220	            kind: "llm.delta",
   221	            contextId: this.contextId,
   222	            timestampMs: Date.now(),
   223	            text: ev.text,
   224	          });
   225	        }
   226	        break;
   227	      case "tool_call":
   228	        await this.handleToolCall(bus, ev);
   229	        break;
   230	      case "response_done":
   231	        this.onResponseDone(bus);
   232	        break;
   233	      case "speech_started":
   234	        this.onSpeechStarted(bus);
   235	        break;
   236	      case "speech_stopped":
   237	        this.onSpeechStopped(bus);
   238	        break;
   239	      case "resumption_handle": {
   240	        // G4: persist-worthy native-resume handle (Gemini). Background route —
   240	        // G4: persist-worthy native-resume handle (Gemini). Background route —
   241	        // a durable host stores the latest and passes it back on reconnect.
   242	        const packet: RealtimeResumptionHandlePacket = {
   243	          kind: "realtime.resumption_handle",
   244	          contextId: this.contextId,
   245	          timestampMs: Date.now(),
   246	          handle: ev.handle,
   247	        };
   248	        bus.push(Route.Background, packet);
   249	        break;
   250	      }
   251	      case "error":
   252	        this.onError(bus, ev.cause, ev.recoverable);
   253	        break;
   254	      default:
   255	        break;
   256	    }
   257	  }
   258	
   259	  private async handleToolCall(
   260	    bus: PipelineBus,
   261	    ev: { toolId: string; toolName: string; args: Record<string, unknown> },
   262	  ): Promise<void> {
   263	    if (ev.toolName === this.delegateToolName) {
   264	      if (this.reasoner) this.dispatchDelegate(bus, ev);
   265	      return;
   266	    }
   267	    if (this.opts.onFrontToolCall) {
   268	      await this.handleFrontTool(bus, ev);
   269	      return;
   270	    }
   271	    // No front-tool handler: with a reasoner, an unexpected tool is a recoverable error
   272	    // (without one, tool calls are ignored, as before).
   273	    if (this.reasoner) {
   274	      const cause = new Error(`Unexpected tool call "${ev.toolName}" (expected "${this.delegateToolName}")`);
   275	      if (this.opts.debug) console.error("[realtime-bridge]", cause.message);
   276	      this.onError(bus, cause, true);
   277	    }
   278	  }
   279	
   280	  private async handleFrontTool(
   281	    bus: PipelineBus,
   282	    ev: { toolId: string; toolName: string; args: Record<string, unknown> },
   283	  ): Promise<void> {
   284	    if (!this.opts.onFrontToolCall) return;
   285	    let result: string;
   286	    try {
   287	      result = (await this.opts.onFrontToolCall({ toolId: ev.toolId, toolName: ev.toolName, args: ev.args })) ?? "";
   288	    } catch (err) {
   289	      this.onError(bus, err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)), true);
   290	      return;
   291	    }
   292	    this.adapter.injectToolResult(ev.toolId, result);
   293	  }
   294	
   295	  /**
   296	   * Start the reasoner delegate OFF the serial event pump. The pump must keep draining adapter
   297	   * events during the multi-second reasoner "thinking gap" — above all `speech_started`, so a
   298	   * barge-in mid-delegate still fires `interrupt.detected` and (via `interrupt.tts`) aborts the
   299	   * now-unwanted delegate before its answer is voiced over the user. Awaiting the delegate inside
   300	   * the pump loop (the old shape) froze barge-in for the entire gap. `runDelegate` sets
   301	   * `this.inflight` synchronously before its first await, so a subsequently-pumped barge-in sees
   302	   * a live controller to abort.
   303	   */
   304	  private dispatchDelegate(
   305	    bus: PipelineBus,
   306	    ev: { toolId: string; toolName: string; args: Record<string, unknown> },
   307	  ): void {
   308	    this.delegateTask = this.runDelegate(bus, ev).catch((err) => {
   309	      if (!this.bus || isAbortError(err)) return;
   310	      this.onError(bus, err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)), false);
   311	    });
   312	  }
   313	
   314	  private async runDelegate(
   315	    bus: PipelineBus,
   316	    ev: { toolId: string; toolName: string; args: Record<string, unknown> },
   317	  ): Promise<void> {
   318	    // Pin the turn's contextId now: the pump keeps advancing while the delegate streams, so
   319	    // this.contextId may move to a later turn before we finish. The tool_call/tool_result pair
   320	    // must stay bound to the turn that issued the call (R1: never merge parts across turns).
   321	    const contextId = this.contextId;
   322	    if (!contextId) return;
   323	
   324	    const toolCall: LlmToolCallPacket = {
   325	      kind: "llm.tool_call",
   326	      contextId,
   327	      timestampMs: Date.now(),
   328	      toolId: ev.toolId,
   329	      toolName: ev.toolName,
   330	      toolArgs: ev.args,
   331	    };
   332	    bus.push(Route.Main, toolCall);
   333	
   334	    const queryArg = this.opts.delegateQueryArg ?? "query";
   335	    const rawQuery = ev.args[queryArg];
   336	    const userText = typeof rawQuery === "string" ? rawQuery : "";
   337	    if (userText.trim().length === 0) {
   338	      this.onError(
   339	        bus,
   340	        new Error(`delegate tool "${ev.toolName}" called without a string "${queryArg}" argument`),
   341	        true,
   342	      );
   343	      return;
   344	    }
   345	
   346	    const controller = new AbortController();
   347	    this.inflight = controller;
   348	    let answer = "";
   349	    let grounded = false;
   350	
   351	    // G2 observability: the query is on its way to the reasoner (Background route, R4).
   352	    const queryStartedMs = Date.now();
   353	    const delegateQuery: DelegateQueryPacket = {
   354	      kind: "delegate.query",
   355	      contextId,
   356	      timestampMs: queryStartedMs,
   357	      query: userText,
   358	      toolId: ev.toolId,
   359	      toolName: ev.toolName,
   360	    };
   361	    bus.push(Route.Background, delegateQuery);
   362	
   363	    try {
   364	      const messages = this.opts.contextProvider?.() ?? [];
   365	      for await (const part of this.reasoner!.stream({
   366	        userText,
   367	        toolArgs: ev.args,
   368	        messages,
   369	        signal: controller.signal,
   370	      })) {
   371	        switch (part.type) {
   372	          case "text-delta":
   373	            answer += part.text;
   374	            break;
   375	          case "tool-result":
   376	            grounded = true;
   377	            break;
   378	          case "finish":
   379	            if (!answer && part.text) answer = part.text;
   380	            break;
   381	          case "suspended": {
   382	            const cause = new Error(
   383	              part.prompt ?? "delegate suspended — cannot voice inline without resume",
   384	            );
   385	            if (this.opts.debug) console.error("[realtime-bridge]", cause.message, part.payload);
   386	            this.onError(bus, cause, false);
   387	            return;
   388	          }
   389	          case "error":
   390	            if (!part.recoverable) throw part.cause;
   391	            this.onError(bus, part.cause, true);
   392	            return;
   393	        }
   394	      }
   395	    } catch (err) {
   396	      if (isAbortError(err)) return;
   397	      this.onError(bus, err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)), false);
   398	      return;
   399	    } finally {
   400	      // Only clear if still ours — a newer delegate may have replaced this.inflight.
   401	      if (this.inflight === controller) this.inflight = undefined;
   402	    }
   403	
   404	    if (answer.length === 0) {
   405	      this.onError(bus, new Error("delegate produced no output"), false);
   406	      return;
   407	    }
   408	
   409	    const answeredMs = Date.now();
   410	    const toolResult: LlmToolResultPacket = {
   411	      kind: "llm.tool_result",
   412	      contextId,
   413	      timestampMs: answeredMs,
   414	      toolId: ev.toolId,
   415	      toolName: ev.toolName,
   416	      result: answer,
   417	    };
   418	    bus.push(Route.Main, toolResult);
   419	    // G2 observability: the reasoner produced the final answer (Background route, R4).
   420	    const delegateResult: DelegateResultPacket = {
   421	      kind: "delegate.result",
   422	      contextId,
   423	      timestampMs: answeredMs,
   424	      query: userText,
   425	      answer,
   426	      durationMs: answeredMs - queryStartedMs,
   427	      grounded,
   428	      toolId: ev.toolId,
   429	      toolName: ev.toolName,
   430	    };
   431	    bus.push(Route.Background, delegateResult);
   432	    this.adapter.injectToolResult(ev.toolId, this.formatToolResult(answer));
   433	  }
   434	
   435	  /** G1: wrap the buffered delegate answer for the front model (synchronous — R2). */
   436	  private formatToolResult(answer: string): string {
   437	    if (this.opts.toolResultFormat === "string") return answer;
   438	    const envelope: DelegateResultEnvelope = {
   439	      response_text: answer,
   440	      require_repeat_verbatim: true,
   441	      ...(this.opts.renderDirective ? { render: this.opts.renderDirective } : {}),
   442	    };
   443	    return JSON.stringify(envelope);
   444	  }
   445	
   446	  private onSpeechStarted(bus: PipelineBus): void {
   447	    if (!this.adapter.caps.emitsServerSpeechStarted || !this.contextId) return;
   448	    const packet: InterruptionDetectedPacket = {
   449	      kind: "interrupt.detected",
   450	      contextId: this.contextId,
   451	      timestampMs: Date.now(),
   452	      source: "vad",
   453	    };
   454	    bus.push(Route.Critical, packet);
   455	  }
   456	
   457	  private onSpeechStopped(bus: PipelineBus): void {
   458	    if (!this.contextId) return;
   459	    bus.push(Route.Main, {
   460	      kind: "vad.speech_ended",
   461	      contextId: this.contextId,
   462	      timestampMs: Date.now(),
   463	    });
   464	  }
   465	
   466	  private onResponseStarted(bus: PipelineBus): void {
   467	    const previousContextId = this.contextId;
   468	    this.contextId = crypto.randomUUID();
   469	    this.turnUserText = "";
   470	    this.turnAssistantText = "";
   471	    this.turnAssistantDeltas = "";
   472	    this.playedMs = 0;
   473	    this.audioRemainder = new Uint8Array(0);
   474	    const packet: TurnChangePacket = {
   475	      kind: "turn.change",
   476	      contextId: this.contextId,
   477	      previousContextId,
   478	      reason: "realtime_response_started",
   479	      timestampMs: Date.now(),
   480	    };
   481	    bus.push(Route.Main, packet);
   482	  }
   483	
   484	  private onAudio(bus: PipelineBus, pcm16: Uint8Array, sampleRateHz: number): void {
   485	    if (!this.contextId) return;
   486	    const resampled = resamplePcm16Bytes(pcm16, sampleRateHz, ENGINE_SAMPLE_RATE_HZ);
   487	    this.audioRemainder = concatBytes(this.audioRemainder, resampled);
   488	    this.emitCoalescedAudio(bus, false);
   489	  }
   490	
   491	  private onFinalTranscript(bus: PipelineBus, text: string): void {
   492	    if (!this.contextId || text.trim().length === 0) return;
   493	    this.turnUserText = text;
   494	    const packet: SttResultPacket = {
   495	      kind: "stt.result",
   496	      contextId: this.contextId,
   497	      timestampMs: Date.now(),
   498	      text,
   499	      confidence: 0,
   500	    };

   265	      // Release the keepAlive lease + drop the controller on ANY close — a client
   266	      // close (pumped via the Agent's onClose hook) OR an edge-runner-initiated
   267	      // socket.dispose() (idle / max-duration / startup failure). The socket fires
   268	      // its close handlers in both cases, so this does not depend on the platform
   269	      // delivering a server-initiated onClose.
   270	      socket.onClose(() => this.#releaseConnection(connection.id));

   273	      // evicted mid-conversation.

   275	        .then((dispose) => {
   276	          if (this.#controllers.has(connection.id)) {
   277	            this.#keepAliveDispose.set(connection.id, dispose);
   278	          } else {
   279	            // Connection already closed before the lease resolved.
   280	            dispose();
   281	          }
   282	        })
   283	        .catch(() => {
   284	          // keepAlive() failed — the call still runs (the open socket keeps the
   285	          // isolate live), it is just not protected from idle eviction.

+/**
+ * In-memory emulation of the DO-SQLite statements SqliteReasonerSessionStore issues,
+ * shared across agent instances to simulate one Durable Object across evictions.
+ */
+function sqliteFake() {
+  const history = new Map<string, Array<{ seq: number; role: string; content: string; tool_call_id: string | null }>>();
+  const handles = new Map<string, string>();
+  const sql = (strings: TemplateStringsArray, ...values: unknown[]): unknown[] => {
+    const query = strings.join("?").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
+    if (query.startsWith("CREATE TABLE")) return [];
+    if (query.includes("SELECT role, content, tool_call_id FROM syrinx_reasoner_history")) {
+      return [...(history.get(String(values[0])) ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
+    }
+    if (query.includes("DELETE FROM syrinx_reasoner_history")) {
+      history.delete(String(values[0]));
+      return [];
+    }
+    if (query.includes("INSERT INTO syrinx_reasoner_history")) {
+      const [sid, seq, role, content, toolCallId] = values;
+      const rows = history.get(String(sid)) ?? [];
+      rows.push({
+        seq: Number(seq),
+        role: String(role),
+        content: String(content),
+        tool_call_id: toolCallId === null ? null : String(toolCallId),
+      });
+      history.set(String(sid), rows);
+      return [];
+    }
+    if (query.includes("SELECT handle FROM syrinx_resume_handle")) {
+      const handle = handles.get(String(values[0]));
+      return handle ? [{ handle }] : [];
+    }
+    if (query.includes("DELETE FROM syrinx_resume_handle")) {
+      handles.delete(String(values[0]));
+      return [];
+    }
+    if (query.includes("INSERT INTO syrinx_resume_handle")) {
+      handles.set(String(values[0]), String(values[1]));
+      return [];
+    }
+    return [];
+  };
+  return { sql, history, handles };
+}

   177	const DEFAULT_OUTBOUND_FRAME_DURATION_MS = 20;
   178	// Bounds queue memory + sanity only — interrupt/clear keeps barge-in instant
   179	// regardless of queue depth, and TTS providers burst whole replies ahead of
   180	// realtime. A tiny cap silently drops the tail of every long reply.
   181	const DEFAULT_MAX_QUEUED_OUTPUT_AUDIO_MS = 60_000;

   183	export async function createVoiceWebSocketServer(
   184	  options: VoiceWebSocketServerOptions,
   185	): Promise<VoiceWebSocketServer> {
   186	  const ownsHttpServer = !options.server;
   187	  const httpServer = options.server ?? createServer();
   188	  const routedWebSocket = createRoutedWebSocketServer(httpServer, options.path ?? "/ws", {
   189	    maxConcurrentSessions: positiveInteger(options.maxConcurrentSessions) ?? undefined,
   190	    maxConcurrentSessionsScope: options.maxConcurrentSessionsScope,
   191	    onAdmissionRejected: () => options.onTransportMetric?.(TRANSPORT_ADMISSION_REJECTED_METRIC),
   192	    authorize: options.authorize,
   193	  });
   194	  const wsServer = routedWebSocket.wsServer;
   195	  const sessionStore = options.sessionStore ?? new InMemorySessionStore();
   196	  const sessionIdFn = options.sessionId ?? defaultSessionId;
   197	  const contextIdFn = options.contextId ?? defaultContextId;
   198	  const inputSampleRateHz = positiveInteger(options.inputSampleRateHz) ?? 16000;
   199	  const outputSampleRateHz = positiveInteger(options.outputSampleRateHz) ?? 16000;
   200	  const rawBinaryInput = options.rawBinaryInput ?? false;
   201	  const binaryAudioEnvelope = options.binaryAudioEnvelope ?? true;
   202	  const browserOpusDownlink = options.browserOpusDownlink ?? true;
   203	  const resumeWindowMs = nonNegativeInteger(options.resumeWindowMs) ?? DEFAULT_RESUME_WINDOW_MS;
   204	  const outboundFrameDurationMs = positiveInteger(options.outboundFrameDurationMs) ?? DEFAULT_OUTBOUND_FRAME_DURATION_MS;
   205	  const maxQueuedOutputAudioMs = positiveInteger(options.maxQueuedOutputAudioMs) ?? DEFAULT_MAX_QUEUED_OUTPUT_AUDIO_MS;
   206	  const hostConfig: TransportHostConfig = {
   207	    heartbeatIntervalMs: nonNegativeInteger(options.heartbeatIntervalMs) ?? DEFAULT_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS,
   208	    startupTimeoutMs: nonNegativeInteger(options.startupTimeoutMs) ?? DEFAULT_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS,
   209	    maxSessionDurationMs: nonNegativeInteger(options.maxSessionDurationMs) ?? DEFAULT_MAX_SESSION_DURATION_MS,
   210	    maxBufferedAmountBytes: positiveInteger(options.maxBufferedAmountBytes) ?? DEFAULT_MAX_BUFFERED_AMOUNT_BYTES,
   211	    maxInboundMessageBytes: positiveInteger(options.maxInboundMessageBytes) ?? DEFAULT_MAX_INBOUND_MESSAGE_BYTES,
   212	  };
   213	  const gracefulCloseRegistry = new Map<WebSocket, (deadlineMs: number) => Promise<void>>();
   214	
   215	  const adapter: TransportAdapter<BrowserConnectionState> = {
   216	    createState: () => ({
   217	      managed: null,
   218	      initialContextId: contextIdFn(),
   219	      outboundHandle: null,
   220	      opusCodec: null,
   221	      browserOpusDownlink: browserOpusDownlink,
   222	      streamingResamplers: new Map(),
   223	    }),
   224	
   225	    async acquireSession({ request, state, shouldAbort, onSessionCreated }) {
   226	      const requestedSessionId = sanitizeSessionId(sessionIdFromRequest(request) ?? sessionIdFn(request));
   227	      const leased = await sessionStore.lease(requestedSessionId, async () => {
   228	        const sess = await options.createSession(request);
   229	        onSessionCreated(sess);
   230	        if (shouldAbort()) {
   231	          await sess.close().catch(() => undefined);
   232	          throw new Error("websocket session startup aborted");
   233	        }
   234	        await sess.start();
   235	        if (shouldAbort()) {
   236	          await sess.close().catch(() => undefined);
   237	          throw new Error("websocket session startup aborted");
   238	        }
   239	        return {
   240	          id: requestedSessionId,
   241	          session: sess,
   242	          currentContextId: state.initialContextId,
   243	          contextSampleRates: new Map(),
   244	          inputSequence: { lastSequence: null },
   245	          turnMetricsTurns: new Map(),
   246	          closeTimer: null,
   247	          connectionCount: 1,
   248	        };
   249	      });
   250	      state.managed = leased.managed;
   251	      return { session: leased.managed.session, resumed: leased.resumed };
   252	    },
   253	
   254	    wireSession(session, socket, state, disposers) {
   255	      const managed = state.managed;
   256	      if (!managed) throw new Error("websocket session missing managed state");
   257	      state.opusCodec = createBrowserOpusCodec(BROWSER_OPUS_SAMPLE_RATE_HZ);
   258	      state.outboundHandle = wireBrowserSessionEvents(
   259	        session,
   260	        socket,
   261	        disposers,
   262	        outputSampleRateHz,
   263	        binaryAudioEnvelope,
   264	        hostConfig.maxBufferedAmountBytes,
   265	        outboundFrameDurationMs,
   266	        maxQueuedOutputAudioMs,
   267	        state.opusCodec,
   268	        inputSampleRateHz,
   269	        () => state.browserOpusDownlink,
   270	        managed.turnMetricsTurns,
   271	        state.streamingResamplers,
   272	        options.backgroundAudio ? new BackgroundAudioMixer(options.backgroundAudio) : undefined,
   273	      );
   274	      gracefulCloseRegistry.set(socket, (deadlineMs) => {
   275	        if (socket.readyState === WebSocket.CLOSED || socket.readyState === WebSocket.CLOSING) {
   276	          return Promise.resolve();
   277	        }
   278	        if (state.outboundHandle) {
   279	          return state.outboundHandle.drainAndClose(socket, deadlineMs);
   280	        }
   281	        return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
   282	          let settled = false;
   283	          const settle = () => { if (!settled) { settled = true; resolve(); } };
   284	          const deadlineTimer = setTimeout(() => {
   285	            if (socket.readyState !== WebSocket.CLOSED && socket.readyState !== WebSocket.CLOSING) {
   286	              socket.terminate();
   287	            }
   288	            settle();
   289	          }, Math.max(0, deadlineMs - Date.now()));
   290	          (deadlineTimer as NodeJS.Timeout).unref?.();
   291	          socket.once("close", () => { clearTimeout(deadlineTimer); settle(); });
   292	          closeWebSocketWithFallback(socket, 1001, "server going away");
   293	        });
   294	      });
   295	      disposers.push(() => gracefulCloseRegistry.delete(socket));
   296	      return () => undefined;
   297	    },
   298	
   299	    processMessage(data, isBinary, session, state) {
   300	      if (!state.managed) return;
   301	      const managed = state.managed;
   302	      sessionStore.update(managed.id, (stored) => {
   303	        stored.currentContextId = handleClientMessage(
   304	          session,
   305	          data,
   306	          isBinary,
   307	          stored.currentContextId,
   308	          contextIdFn,
   309	          inputSampleRateHz,
   310	          rawBinaryInput,
   311	          stored.contextSampleRates,
   312	          stored.inputSequence,
   313	          state.opusCodec,
   314	          inputSampleRateHz,
   315	          state,
   316	          state.streamingResamplers,
   317	        );
   318	      });
   319	    },
   320	
   321	    onDisconnect(_session, state, { maxSessionTimedOut }) {
   322	      if (state.managed) {
   323	        state.managed.connectionCount = Math.max(0, state.managed.connectionCount - 1);
   324	        void sessionStore.release(state.managed.id, maxSessionTimedOut ? 0 : resumeWindowMs);
   325	      }
   326	    },
   327	
   328	    onStartupTimeout(_state, session) {
   329	      void session.close().catch(() => undefined);
   330	    },
   331	
   332	    sendReady(session, socket, state, resumed, config) {
   333	      const managed = state.managed;

   905	function optionalSequence(value: unknown): number | undefined {
   906	  if (value === undefined) return undefined;
   907	  if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(value) || value < 0) {
   908	    throw new Error("Websocket audio sequence must be a non-negative integer");
   909	  }
   910	  return value;
   911	}
   912	
   913	function requiredJsonAudioSampleRate(value: unknown): number {
   914	  if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(value) || value <= 0) {
   915	    throw new Error("JSON websocket audio sampleRateHz must be a positive integer");
   916	  }
   917	  return value;
   918	}
   919	
   920	function sessionIdFromRequest(request: IncomingMessage): string | null {
   921	  const url = request.url;
   922	  if (!url) return null;
   923	  try {
   924	    const parsed = new URL(url, "http://localhost");
   925	    return parsed.searchParams.get("sessionId") ?? parsed.searchParams.get("session_id");
   926	  } catch {
   927	    return null;
   928	  }
   929	}
   930	
   931	function sanitizeSessionId(value: string): string {
   932	  const trimmed = value.trim();
   933	  if (/^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$/.test(trimmed)) return trimmed;
   934	  return defaultSessionId();
   935	}
